description: Management of Municipal Waste by Governorate is a series of data sets listed in Bahrain Open Data Portal (data.gov.bh), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ministry of Municipalities Affairs & Agriculture. Municipal Waste Collected from Households by Governorate. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Municipalities Affairs & Agriculture. Its tags are Waste, Governorates. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-07-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
